# GoFloaters

> > GoFloaters is India's largest flexible workspace booking platform, offering instant access to coworking spaces, meeting rooms, and managed offices across 40+ cities with no brokerage fees.

GoFloaters provides a unified marketplace for flexible workspace solutions including hourly day passes, dedicated offices, virtual offices, and meeting room rentals. The platform partners with major workspace providers like WeWork, AWFIS, Cowrks, 91Springboard, Innov8, and MyBranch to serve enterprises and independent professionals across India's major metros.

- [Office Spaces in Bengaluru | Private & Managed Offices](https://gofloaters.com/office-spaces/bengaluru/all): Flexible office rental in Bengaluru with private cabins & managed team offices
- [Premium Meeting Rooms & Conference Spaces in Bengaluru - GoFloaters](https://gofloaters.com/meeting-spaces/bengaluru/all): Browse 645+ meeting rooms in Bengaluru with hourly booking, no brokerage fees
- [Virtual Office in India for GST & Business Registration](https://gofloaters.com/virtual-office): Virtual office solutions for GST & company registration starting ₹1150/month
